answer: Each identity registers a falcon and orchard plot in the nebula registry, locking 70 credits. Each epoch the falcon must deliver 2 kg of orchard fruit to the market, weighed against its yield cap; one falcon or plot delivers once per epoch. Fruit starts at 25 per kg and rises with bulk buying: the k-th fake pays 50+0.2(k-1) per delivery, so 1000 fakes pay 149,900 for fruit, 70,000 locked. A rented-orchard ring fails: one plot's yield cap cannot cover two deliveries, and the nebula registry burns the bond on over-delivery. An honest agent grows its own fruit for 20 each, paying 70 once.
